mechanism: Betamethasone may increase vancomycin nephrotoxicity risk and reduce its antimicrobial efficacy through immunosuppression; vancomycin nephrotoxicity is potentiated by corticosteroid-induced fluid retention and electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, ensure vancomycin therapeutic drug monitoring, and use lowest effective betamethasone dose for shortest duration possible.
